findings.note: ESPN's injury report lists Chicago's Connor Bedard (C) as OUT until about Nov 11, along with Mangiapane, Grzelcyk and Levshunov. Boston is missing Charlie McAvoy, Nikita Zadorov and Dans Locmelis, so both blue lines are thinner, which could cut the other way. No starting goalies were shown.
NHL.com preview: Chicago is 4-9-0 and 1-4-0 in its last five, with only six goals in that span. Boston is 9-4-1 and leads the Atlantic but has lost its last two games.
ESPN team stats show Chicago scoring 2.08 goals per game but allowing 3.69, which ranks 29th. That leaky defense against a strong Boston team is the main path to the Over.
